stages.title: Understand the language
stages.instructions: Read the explanation, examples, common error, and recap.

blocks.text: This lesson prepares you to discuss an opinion, solve a technology detail, and agree on a social plan. The central language is integrated A2 tense and function review. It belongs to the practical context of opinions, technology & social life. Focus first on meaning: decide what information the listener needs. Then choose the subject, verb form, and useful detail. At A2, connect the main message to a time, reason, contrast, or result. Listen for context before choosing the tense or functional phrase. The same language returns in the listening, repeat, speaking, exercises, and guided conversation stages.

blocks.title: Pattern
blocks.text: integrated A2 tense and function review

blocks.english: I think the event will be fun, but the tickets are expensive.
blocks.explanation: Use this model to begin the a2 real-life mission exchange.

blocks.english: Let's meet at the place where we had coffee.
blocks.explanation: This a2 real-life mission model adds a different detail or response.
Use this question or response to keep the a2 real-life mission exchange moving.

blocks.text: Notice the two models: “I think the event will be fun, but the tickets are expensive.” and “Let's meet at the place where we had coffee.” They show the pattern in complete communication, not as isolated grammar. Say the model aloud, replace one detail, and check that the new sentence keeps the intended meaning. When the other person asks a follow-up question, answer directly and add a relevant detail. This makes the exchange natural while keeping the language controlled. Compare the time and viewpoint in each model, and use a linker when two ideas need a clear relationship. Avoid adding advanced forms when the lesson pattern already communicates the message accurately.

blocks.title: Common error
blocks.text: Do not mix the word order or verb form with another pattern. Keep the controlled form for this lesson: integrated A2 tense and function review.
